To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) cultural neuroscientists use a rigid and evaluative concept of culture, (2) they use a narrow concept of culture and (3) they use an essentialist concept of culture.

the cultural neuroscience approach is based on an implicit definition of culture, that it is not possible to measure culture with brain scans and that the cultural neuroscience research program has to be redefined.
culture can be understood as an open, dynamic and evaluative process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to understand culture in a way that is compatible with a scientific approach.
the following questions: How does culture influence the brain, and how is the brain influenced by culture?
the question of whether the concept of culture in CN is appropriate for understanding cultural phenomena and how it can be improved.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the current state of CN research is not able to provide an adequate account of culture.
CN has the potential to contribute to our understanding of culture, but it is currently not able to do so.
the current state of the art in CN is not yet ready to make any conclusive statements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the current cultural neuroscientific models are too narrow to be able to explain the complex phenomenon of human culture.
CN should be more critical about its implicit assumptions and should take into account the dynamic, flexible, and relational nature of culture.
cultural neuroscience is a promising field of research, but its current state is characterized by a lack of critical reflection on the concept of culture and the methodological approaches.
The main takeaway from our work is that

cultural neuroscience should not be seen as a discipline that studies the biological underpinnings of cultural differences, but rather as a field that investigates cultural phenomena by using neuroscience methods.
cultural neuroscience is in need of an explicit and thorough discussion of the concept of culture.
the field of CN is still young.
